newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Seal in China timber venture.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Seal in China timber venture.

text.p: Seal Inc Bhd said on Wednesday it has signed a joint venture agreement to manufacture block board in China.
The joint venture with Jingsha Forestry Enterprise (JFE) is for a period of 50 years, Seal said in a statement.
Total investment in the project is estimated at 10.08 million ringgit, it said.
Seal will take up a 70 percent stake in the joint venture with the Chinese partner holding 30 percent.
Seal said the project is expected to generate annual sales revenue of 22.6 million ringgit when fully operational from the second year onward.
